content.title: Catastrophe-to-Miniature Reveal | Scale Pullback and Set Proof
content.summary: A desert dust catastrophe crosses a model observatory before dust blowers, camera rail and monitor reveal its construction. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One fictional geography and at least three repeated scale anchors are established before the hazard grows. + The catastrophe advances through the same geography in a readable order rather than resetting locations. + One full-frame physical occlusion bridges the fictional event to the production layer. + The revealed set contains at least three legible production cues that causally explain the preceding effect. + A monitoring layer preserves the opening fiction and confirms the miniature-to-image relationship.
quick_start.recommended_input: Establish an original silver monorail crossing a compact desert observatory model with one red canyon, three white domes and a fixed left-to-right route. Let the dust cross the first dome, engulf the rail and push one lightweight antenna panel toward camera; no person or vehicle changes identity. Reveal a tabletop canyon, two controlled dust blowers, a motion-control rail and three clearly adult crew silhouettes; hold one monitor showing the original monorail frame and the exact short question "HOW BIG?".
required_anchors: One fictional geography and at least three repeated scale anchors are established before the hazard grows.
The catastrophe advances through the same geography in a readable order rather than resetting locations.
The revealed set contains at least three legible production cues that causally explain the preceding effect.
A monitoring layer preserves the opening fiction and confirms the miniature-to-image relationship.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A desert dust catastrophe crosses a model observatory before dust blowers, camera rail and monitor reveal its construction. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 先让列车、海岸与建筑共享一个可信地理，再让巨浪沿同一轴线逐层吞没铁路和街区；水雾遮满画面后揭开微缩布景、轨道摄影机、操作人员与水槽，让最后一层明确解释前面的灾难效果。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One fictional geography and at least three repeated scale anchors are established before the hazard grows.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One fictional geography and at least three repeated scale anchors are established before the hazard grows."

invariants.rule: The catastrophe advances through the same geography in a readable order rather than resetting locations.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "The catastrophe advances through the same geography in a readable order rather than resetting locations."

invariants.rule: One full-frame physical occlusion bridges the fictional event to the production layer.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "One full-frame physical occlusion bridges the fictional event to the production layer."

invariants.rule: The revealed set contains at least three legible production cues that causally explain the preceding effect.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "The revealed set contains at least three legible production cues that causally explain the preceding effect."

invariants.rule: A monitoring layer preserves the opening fiction and confirms the miniature-to-image relationship.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "A monitoring layer preserves the opening fiction and confirms the miniature-to-image relationship."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
